scope: Development-only exploratory precision-recall decision analysis. The original final test was completed under its historical freeze on 2026-10-22, then examined diagnostically. No new independent test is available. The previously seen development audit is an exploratory fixed-rule recheck.
fit_scope: All matched models trained on the same fixed train partition; no refit in this final decision analysis. RF probabilities come from the geometry experiment; CNN probabilities are stable softmax of already saved round2 screen baseline logits, with zero logit biases.
probability_contract: Nine fixed columns, finite nonnegative rows summing to one, ordered by increasing development cache index within tune/audit. Scores are uncalibrated model outputs; a threshold of t is not a calibrated real-world failure probability.
business_assumption: Precision >= 80% is an experimental illustration, not a factory-approved cost or operational requirement.
threshold_selection_unit: One threshold per fitted model and seed, chosen on tune only; this is a model-specific validation procedure, not one universal threshold for all fits.
eligible_thresholds: Every distinct Scratch score observed in tune; predict Scratch one-vs-rest iff score >= threshold. At least one predicted positive is mandatory. Precision feasibility is exactly 5*TP >= 4*(TP+FP), avoiding floating-point feasibility boundaries.
selection_order: Maximize true-positive count (equivalently recall because tune support is fixed); ties prefer larger exact TP/(TP+FP), then larger threshold.
no_feasible_threshold: Record threshold=null, status=no_rule_selected. Do not count an all-negative rule as Precision=1 and do not pick a best-effort threshold. No thresholded nine-class audit result is generated for such a model; argmax and AP remain reportable.
decision_grids: Save a descriptive grid at t=0,0.05,...,1 plus any selected threshold for both tune and fixed exploratory audit. The audit grid is descriptive only and must never select or alter a threshold. Save all tune candidate operating points for exact selection reproducibility.
binary_metrics: normal-to-Scratch false positives per 1000 true normal wafers
average_precision: Non-interpolated step area sum over increasing recall increments times precision at each tied-score boundary. Do not substitute trapezoidal PR area.
zero_denominator: Precision is null when no examples are predicted positive. Plotting may include the conventional recall=0/precision=1 endpoint but it is labeled as a convention and is never eligible for threshold selection.
nine_class_rule: If p(Scratch)>=frozen threshold, output Scratch; otherwise output argmax of the remaining eight class scores. Report the full confusion matrix, fixed-nine-class Macro-F1, accuracy, per-class precision/recall/F1/support, Scratch errors and total normal-to-any-defect errors alongside the unmodified nine-class argmax reference.
freeze_and_audit_sequence: Write a single threshold_selection.json with all model/seed thresholds and tune probability source hashes before loading any audit probability or audit logits for this analysis. Then apply those exact decisions to fixed audit rows; no threshold, model, seed, subset or preprocessing adjustment follows the audit.
historical_reference: Historical official RF/CNN lot-validation and original final-test metrics are retained in separate tables with their original partitions and frozen provenance. They must not be merged into matched new-split comparison claims.
uncertainty: Three seeds share the same heldout wafers. Do not count seed repetitions as independent samples. Tune contains 99 and audit 80 true Scratches; precision-floor feasibility is an observed point estimate, not a confidence-bound guarantee.
stop_rule: Run this fixed PR analysis once for the declared models; no extra model training, bias search, retuning on audit, or fresh official-test scoring.
